planets.name: HAT-P-16 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-16 with a 2.78-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: HAT-P-16 b was found in 2010 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-16. Its orbit and size follow Alexoudi 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ALEXOUDI_2022): disc_year 2010, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.77596727, pl_radj 1.31, pl_bmassj 4.221

thermal.source: Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 4.5 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)
thermal.chosen: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
